title: Launcher's source-owner refusal drops the host's reason and names the wrong remedy
outcome: When the TermAl host refuses the session's source-owner metadata, the launcher's refusal states the host's reason and the remedy that fits it. Admission still stops on any refused request, as docs/test.md specifies (no hostless fallback).
acceptance: When the source-owner GET returns a non-2xx status whose bounded JSON body carries an `error` string, the launcher reports "source owner metadata refused (<status>: <reason>); no tests started", with the host's `code` included when it is a lowercase snake_case identifier. <reason> has control and format characters escaped and is cut at 512 characters with the received length stated. A missing, non-JSON or oversized body, or one without `error`, keeps today's "(<status>)" form, and no other body content is echoed. Shown by behavioural launcher tests, RED first, with a fake host returning 409 with {"error":"Engram source owner binaryPath is not configured for this project"}, a reason containing control characters that is over 512 characters, and a malformed body.

For that refusal, in default (automatic), --input commit and --input plain modes alike, the message names the remedy: configure the project's Engram binaryPath, or run hostless (TERMAL_BASE_URL, TERMAL_SESSION_ID and TERMAL_CLI unset, with an absolute ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY) for evidence only, without verification credit. It does not append "register at start with --input commit in the claim's named root". Other refusals keep their current remedies, including an unreachable host and malformed metadata. Shown by behavioural tests in the three modes.

Product semantics are unchanged: any refused source-owner GET still stops admission before a run directory exists; pinned admission, registration and input selection are untouched; docs/test.md changes only where it describes this refusal's text; and the existing launcher tests pass.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
